about: Public exports exclude UCAR Noah-MP v5 and UGWP under the release ruling of 2026-10-19. Private source builds retain these paths. ArWen physics is the default; held MPAS selections name their licence and missing public port. Paths are relative to the distribution root.

holds.upstream: https://github.com/NCAR/noahmp, as MPAS-Model v8.4.2 carries it in src/core_atmosphere/physics/physics_noahmp
holds.reason: The terms say: 'You shall not sell, license or transfer for a fee the Software, or any work that in any manner contains the Software.' Apache-2.0 grants the right to sell, and the public distribution must stay sellable (owner ruling 2026-10-14), so the hex port of Noah-MP v5.0 and everything that carries or derives from it stay in private builds.
holds.release_when: never on the current terms: UCAR would have to grant terms that permit sale, or a project ruling settles it
holds.native_backend: unaffected: config_lsm_backend='native-cpu' runs Noah-MP from the user's own MPAS build, and only with --licence-opt-in ucar-noahmp
holds.refusal: the forecast door refuses config_lsm_scheme='sf_noahmp' on an MPAS suite without --licence-opt-in ucar-noahmp, naming the terms and the permissive WRF-lineage Noah-MP v4.x of the ArWen suite; with the opt-in it refuses the hex-cuda backend in a distribution without the port by naming this hold (hexcore.licence_gate)

holds.reason: The release ruling explicitly excludes UGWP from the public export. The earlier US Government classification does not release this hold.
holds.release_when: An explicit project ruling lifts this hold.
